eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN IMMEDIATE EVACUATION NOTICE for the following counties or areas: Garfield, CO; at 10:42 AM on AUG 20, 2025 Effective until 11:42 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Zone 265, due to fire, evacuate by noon including Sweetwater, Sweetwater Lake, CR 150 Road and sections of Colorado River Road from Sweetwater to Red Dirt Creek, both in Eagle and Garfield Counties.
